mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHATBOT_MESSAGE (conversation_id, role, content, is_inappropriate, created_at) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, IFNULL(#{isInappropriate}, 0), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT message_id, conversation_id, role, content, is_inappropriate, created_at FROM CHATBOT_MESSAGE WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT message_id, conversation_id, role, content, is_inappropriate, created_at FROM CHATBOT_MESSAGE WHERE is_inappropriate = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHATBOT_MESSAGE WHERE is_inappropriate = 1
